title: Package upload endpoint configured over cleartext
description: .pypirc declares an upload `repository` URL that uses cleartext http. The credential and the uploaded artifact travel unencrypted, so a network attacker can read the token and replace the package.
remediation: Upload over https, and rotate any credential used with a cleartext endpoint.
limitation: It matches an upload `repository` URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed .pypirc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
